165: "and a man wrestled with him" what is "and he wrestled"? (sheet: that rabbi yehoshua ben levi says, it teaches that they rose dust with their feet until the throne of glory. it is written here "with his wrestling with him", and it is written (nahum 1:3) "dust of his feet", and that emissary was the master of esav, and he is samael. because of this, his judgement is that he brings up the dust of his feet until the throne of glory, that it is the place of judgement). rabbi shimeon says from dust. dust is adjunct to dirt, what is the difference between dirt and dust. this is the dust that is left over from the fire and does not produce fruit (in the world) ever. dirt that all fruit come out from it and it is general in above and below.

rabbi yehudah says if so what (shmuel I 2:8) "he stands up from dirt a poor one"? he said to him, like it sounds, but in this way he stands up from dirt a poor one, because there he does not have from his bone at all, and from that dirt comes out a poor one that does not have anything, and from that dirt all fruit and all goodies of the world comes out of him. and with it is made all works of the world as it is written, (koheleth 3:20) "the all is from the dirt and the all returns to the dirt". and we learned everything is from the dirt and even the sphere of the sun. but dust does not produce fruits and buds (to world) to the worlds, and therefore, "and a man dusted", that he came in that dust and rode on it, in order to persecute ya'aqov.

"until dawn", that he was made his ruler and was switched. and this will it be to the time to come, because the exile of now is like night, and he is night. and that dust rules over yisrael and they lie to the dust (another), until light rises and day shines. and like this yisrael will rule and to them will be given kingship that they are sanctifiers of the high things. like you say, (daniel 7:27) "and kingship and rulership and greatness that kings under all the heavens is given to the nation sanctifiers of high things, his kingdom is an eternel kindom and all rulers to him serves and listens":
